query: How does resolution time vary across category, priority, and assignment group?

per_column.name: resolution_time_hours
per_column.rationale: This is the focus variable itself expressed in hours (with -1 sentinels for unresolved). It restates resolution_time rather than opening an external relationship to compare against, and as a continuous value it is not a groupable segmentation.

per_column.name: is_resolved
per_column.rationale: A clean binary flag (resolved vs. not) that is external to the focus and offers an interpretable, well-separated segmentation. Comparing resolution_time across resolved/unresolved status is meaningful, though partly definitional for the -1 cases.

per_column.name: priority_rank
per_column.rationale: Priority is already an original column and a stated grouping dimension of the query; a numeric re-encoding of it adds no new external variable. It is interpretable but merely re-encodes existing information.

per_column.name: avg_resolution_hours_by_category
per_column.rationale: A group-mean aggregate of the focus itself keyed on category. It is derived directly from resolution_time, so it restates the focus rather than providing an independent associational variable; its opaque continuous values are not a clean segmentation.

per_column.name: avg_resolution_hours_by_priority
per_column.rationale: Group mean of the focus by priority. Circular restatement of resolution_time, not an external explanatory variable.

per_column.name: avg_resolution_hours_by_assignment_group
per_column.rationale: Group mean of the focus by assignment group. Same circularity; it encodes the answer rather than enabling independent exploration.

judge.rationale: The set largely fails the EDA claim. Three columns are group-mean aggregates of the focus variable itself (by category, priority, assignment group), which are circular restatements of resolution_time rather than external associational variables to segment on. resolution_time_hours is the focus re-expressed. priority_rank merely re-encodes an existing grouping column. Only is_resolved provides a genuine, interpretable external segmentation, and even it is partly definitional. No new external dimensions (e.g., caller/user attributes, business hours, reassignment counts, SLA class) were introduced to open up informative relationships.
